items.title: Lemma 12.6: the Tan-structure associated to a complex analytic space is 0-truncated
items.statement_scope: Let (X,Oalg_X) be a complex analytic space. Then the functor OX:Tan→Shv(X) of Construction 12.5, given by OX(M)(U)=Hom_AnC((U,Oalg_X|U),(M,Oalg_M)), is a 0-truncated Tan-structure on the ∞-topos Shv(X). The whole lemma is retained.

This is above routine API checking but remains a foundational lemma.
